decisive_exclusions.basis: Source documentation identifies an AMNH Arthropod Easy Capture RSS/Darwin Core archive aggregator spanning collection-network projects rather than one repeatable ecological interaction survey.
Source documentation explicitly describes potential host-plant records recovered from a wild-bee collection and labels the source an occurrence dataset.
Source documentation states that GloBI indexes biotic-association records from Field Museum biological collections rather than a common replicated interaction survey.
Source documentation describes bee records served through a portal for species occurrence data; the qualifying programme is Bumble Bee Watch metadata rather than a common network survey.

The v0.5.2 qualifying system is coOccursWith. Co-occurrence is not one of the frozen primary interaction families (mutualism, herbivory, parasitism, predation/consumer-resource), and v0.5 forbids promoting other labels after support is known.

This namespace is the GloBI adapter for Mangal, the already-audited first primary interaction source that failed the frozen joint species-rank gate. It cannot re-enter as independent GloBI evidence after the pre-outcome source switch.
The source is a Pensoft IPT/Darwin Core archive indexer and the v0.5.2 qualifying programme is explicitly AnthWest occurrence records, not a documented replicated interaction network.
Source documentation labels the underlying resource an occurrence dataset and the qualifying programme key is National Biodiversity Data Centre online record submission.
Source documentation identifies an arthropod collection-derived interaction dataset, not a repeatable ecological network sampling programme.

upper_bound_logic: 20 programme-supported namespaces - 9 decisive exclusions = at most 11 possible semantic PASS namespaces. Because the frozen gate requires >=12, no adjudication of the remaining ambiguous namespaces can make the primary joint interaction arm eligible.
finite_family_rule: No third primary interaction source is allowed.
next_action: Record the joint interaction arm as pre-outcome HOLD and continue the independent trait arm; retain GloBI/Mangal only as documented failed qualification routes or possible non-primary descriptive validation, never as generalized primary response evidence.
